_description: Zero-Bug Architecture Chunk 17 — writable-fields whitelist for CarsPaymentSuccessDetails (booking) documents. Source of truth for BOTH firestore.rules AND client-side pre-write validators. Preventing Session 104-class whitelist drift.
_provenance: Extracted 2026-08-01 from zymo-backend/firestore.rules lines 143-180. Regex tightened 2026-08-30 (MAD 20e Item 1c) to anchor on the CarsPaymentSuccessDetails-owner check `vendorId == request.auth.uid` because Item 1c added a sibling `hasOnly(["read"])` in `users/{uid}/messages/{messageId}` earlier in the file and the previous lazy first-match regex would have grabbed that instead.

_kept_field_reason.tripImages: client-side upload path — image URLs added post-trip
_kept_field_reason.Cancelled: booking-lifecycle cancel-marker flag written from client cancel UI
_kept_field_reason.paymentStatus: client reflects post-payment state — backend Cashfree webhook is authoritative
_kept_field_reason.paymentFailureMessage: MAD 20e Item 1a 2026-08-30 — mobile Razorpay PaymentFailed/PaymentCancelled branches write diagnostic string alongside paymentStatus='cancelled' in a single .update(). Without whitelist the whole update rolled back, silently.
_kept_field_reason.zoomcarConfirmationCode: ZoomCar handoff — client writes returned confirmation
_kept_field_reason.partnerReviewRating: 2026-08-14 Finding-#1 fix — partner-side booking-review submission via Zymo-Partner/src/pages/Bookings.tsx:823-826 handleSubmitReview. Retroactive-synced live→git as Session-131 PR #50 2026-08-17; this JSON drift caught by Chunk 17 gate on next deploy.
_kept_field_reason.origin_channel: Phase 1 attribution router (2026-08-31) — client stamps 'web'|'android'|'ios' on setDoc merge at zymo-web/src/hooks/useBookingSave.ts:500. Backend Cashfree receiver (Gap #1) also writes via admin SDK; whitelisting client write is defense-in-depth so the LEAN fast-path browser merge succeeds without silent rules rejection. Read by measurementRouter.js to route GA4 emission.
_kept_field_reason.booking_session_id: Phase 1 attribution router (2026-08-31) — stable per-browser booking-attempt id set by client at bookingAnalytics.ts:23-45. Attribution metadata; no security surface.
_kept_field_reason.app_instance_id: Phase 1 attribution router (2026-08-31) — GA4 native app_instance_id (mobile only; web always null). Read by measurementRouter.js for future native stream routing.

excludedByDesign.postTripCharges: Session 104 — writes now go via partnerSubmitPostTripCharge callable (admin SDK, rule bypass). Direct client writes MUST fail closed.
excludedByDesign.tripPhotos: Session 104 — writes now go via partnerUploadTripPhotos callable. Direct client writes MUST fail closed.
